verdict.rationale: Vercel documents adding custom domains with DNS management and automatic SSL. Its CLI can be run from automated systems to manage DNS records and certificates, and a REST API offers general programmatic account access. Nothing in the evidence shows a multi-tenant SaaS flow: bulk-attaching customer domains to one project, or routing each tenant's hostname to its own content. Missing for 10: documented API endpoints for adding and verifying customer domains, multi-tenant hostname-to-tenant routing, any platforms/multi-tenant guide, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can programmatically provision and route custom domains for my own multi-tenant SaaS customers

citations.quote: Add a custom domain, manage DNS records, and get SSL certificates automatically.

you can interact with the Vercel platform using a terminal, or through an automated system, enabling you to retrieve logs, manage certificates, replicate your deployment environment locally, manage Domain Name System (DNS) records, and more.
